```{r setup, echo=TRUE, results="hide", warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

# load packages required for analysis
library(tibble)
library(pheatmap)
library(ggplot2)
library(DT)
library(openxlsx)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
 # options(warn = -1)

Tag_this_analysis <- "GOheatmap"
data_dir <- "../../data"
output_dir <- "../../output"
dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

```{r, echo=TRUE, results='asis', warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# Specify the file path
file_path <- file.path(data_dir, "GSE315831", "Supplementary_Table_3_Functional_analysis.xlsx")
# Get all sheet names
sheet_names <- getSheetNames(file_path)
sheet_names <- sheet_names[grepl("versus control", sheet_names)]
# Function to read and standardize column names
read_and_standardize <- function(sheet) {
  df <- read.xlsx(file_path, sheet = sheet, colNames = TRUE)

  # Rename `color` → `group` if present
  if ("color" %in% colnames(df)) {
    colnames(df)[colnames(df) == "color"] <- "group"
  }

  # ---- STANDARDIZE COLUMN TYPES ----
  # Ensure ID is character
  if ("ID" %in% colnames(df)) {
    df$ID <- as.character(df$ID)
  }

  # Standardize other potential type conflicts (optional)
  if ("Description" %in% colnames(df)) {
    df$Description <- as.character(df$Description)
  }
  if ("geneID" %in% colnames(df)) {
    df$geneID <- as.character(df$geneID)
  }
  if ("group" %in% colnames(df)) {
    df$group <- as.character(df$group)
  }

  # Add sheet name column
  df$SheetName <- sheet
  print(sheet)
  print(colnames(df))
  df$rank <- seq(1, nrow(df))
  return(df)
}

# Read all sheets, standardize columns, and combine
all_sheets_combined <- lapply(sheet_names, read_and_standardize) %>%
  bind_rows()

GO_ids_top100 <- all_sheets_combined %>%
  filter(rank <= 100) %>%      # pick only top 100 per sheet
  pull(ID) %>%                 # extract ID column
  unique()                     # keep unique GO IDs

# View the first few rows
head(all_sheets_combined)
```

```{r, echo=TRUE, results='asis', warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# Convert p.adjust to -log10 scale
all_sheets_combined <- all_sheets_combined %>%
  mutate(log_padj = -log10(p.adjust))

# Step 1: Filter only GO terms that have at least one group label
filtered_id <- all_sheets_combined %>%
  filter(!is.na(group)) %>%
  select(ID) %>%
  distinct()

# Step 2: Keep only rows with GO IDs present in `filtered_id`
filtered_data <- all_sheets_combined %>%
  semi_join(filtered_id, by = "ID")

# Step 3: Convert data to a wide matrix format (GO IDs as rows, SheetNames as columns)
heatmap_matrix <- filtered_data %>%
  select(ID, SheetName, log_padj) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = SheetName, values_from = log_padj, values_fill = NA) %>%
  column_to_rownames("ID") %>%
  as.matrix()

# Step 4: Create row annotation (GO term groups)
row_annotation <- all_sheets_combined %>%
  filter(!is.na(group)) %>%  # Remove rows where group is NA
  select(ID, group) %>%
  distinct() %>%             # Ensure unique (ID, group) pairs
  group_by(ID) %>%
  slice(1) %>%               # Keep only the first occurrence of each ID
  ungroup() %>%
  column_to_rownames("ID")   # Convert ID into row names for pheatmap
# Define the column annotation (Manually specify 'hyper' or 'hypo' for each SheetName)
column_annotation <- data.frame(
  Regulation = ifelse(grepl("hyper", colnames(heatmap_matrix)), "Hyper", "Hypo")
)

# Convert row names for annotation
rownames(column_annotation) <- colnames(heatmap_matrix)

# Step 5: Generate heatmap
heatmap_matrix[is.na(heatmap_matrix)] <- 0
pheatmap(
  heatmap_matrix,
  annotation_row = row_annotation,  # Annotate rows with group information
  annotation_col = column_annotation, # Column annotation (Hyper/Hypo)
  cluster_rows = FALSE,             # Cluster rows
  cluster_cols = FALSE,             # Cluster columns
  border_color = NA,               # Remove borders
  fontsize = 12,                    # Increase font size
  fontsize_row = 8,                 # Adjust row label font size
  fontsize_col = 10,                 # Adjust column label font size
  width = 15, height = 15,            # High-resolution settings
  filename = "GOheatmap.pdf" # Save high-quality PDF
)

# Save as PNG (optional)
ggsave(file.path(output_dir, "heatmap_high_quality.png"), width = 8, height = 10, dpi = 600)
```

```{r, echo=TRUE, results='asis', warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, dpi=600}
# Convert p.adjust to -log10 scale
all_sheets_combined <- all_sheets_combined %>%
  mutate(log_padj = -log10(p.adjust))

# Step 1: Filter only GO terms that have at least one group label (keep full data)
filtered_id <- all_sheets_combined %>%
  filter(!is.na(group)) %>%
  select(ID) %>%
  distinct()

# Step 2: Keep *all rows* but only for GO IDs in the top100 list
filtered_data <- all_sheets_combined %>%
  filter(ID %in% GO_ids_top100)

# Step 3: Convert data to wide matrix format (GO IDs as rows, SheetNames as columns)
heatmap_matrix <- filtered_data %>%
  select(ID, SheetName, log_padj) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = SheetName, values_from = log_padj, values_fill = NA) %>%
  column_to_rownames("ID") %>%
  as.matrix()

# Step 4: Create row annotation
row_annotation <- all_sheets_combined %>%
  filter(!is.na(group)) %>%
  select(ID, group) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  filter(ID %in% GO_ids_top100) %>%   # Only keep top100 GO terms
  group_by(ID) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  column_to_rownames("ID")

# Step 5: Define column annotation
column_annotation <- data.frame(
  Regulation = ifelse(grepl("hyper", colnames(heatmap_matrix)), "Hyper", "Hypo")
)
rownames(column_annotation) <- colnames(heatmap_matrix)

# Step 6: Extract disease name correctly
clean_names <- colnames(heatmap_matrix) %>%
  sub("^(hyper|hypo)methyl_", "", .) %>%      # remove "hypermethyl_" or "hypomethyl_"
  sub(" versus control$", "", .)              # remove " versus control"

# Now order columns by disease sequence
ordered_columns <- colnames(heatmap_matrix)[
  order(match(clean_names, disease_order))
]

# Step 7: Split into hyper and hypo matrices
hyper_matrix <- heatmap_matrix[, grepl("hyper", colnames(heatmap_matrix))]
hyper_matrix <- hyper_matrix[, ordered_columns[ordered_columns %in% colnames(hyper_matrix)]]

hypo_matrix <- heatmap_matrix[, grepl("hypo", colnames(heatmap_matrix))]
hypo_matrix <- hypo_matrix[, ordered_columns[ordered_columns %in% colnames(hypo_matrix)]]

# Convert NA to 0
hyper_matrix[is.na(hyper_matrix)] <- 0
hypo_matrix[is.na(hypo_matrix)] <- 0

# Step 7b: Order rows by group
ordered_rows <- row_annotation %>%
  arrange(group) %>%
  rownames()

hyper_matrix <- hyper_matrix[ordered_rows, , drop = FALSE]
hypo_matrix <- hypo_matrix[ordered_rows, , drop = FALSE]

# Find where groups change (for row gaps)
group_changes <- which(diff(as.numeric(factor(row_annotation[ordered_rows, "group"]))) != 0)

# Step 8: Draw heatmaps
pheatmap(
  hyper_matrix,
  annotation_row = row_annotation,
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_cols = FALSE,
  border_color = NA,
  fontsize = 12,
  fontsize_row = 8,
  fontsize_col = 10,
  width = 15, height = 15,
  filename = "GOheatmap_hyper.pdf",
  color = colorRampPalette(c("white", "red"))(50),
  gaps_row = group_changes
)

pheatmap(
  hypo_matrix,
  annotation_row = row_annotation,
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_cols = FALSE,
  border_color = NA,
  fontsize = 12,
  fontsize_row = 8,
  fontsize_col = 10,
  width = 15, height = 15,
  filename = "GOheatmap_hypo.pdf",
  color = colorRampPalette(c("white", "blue"))(50),
  gaps_row = group_changes
)
```
